Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped in the right lane at a trafifc signal when the vehicle operated by Driver 2 struck the rear of Driver
1's vehicle. The impact was consistent with a moderate rear-end collision, and both vehicles sustained visible
damage at the rear and front respectively. Driver 1 reported neck strain at the scene and was evaluated by
responding medical personnel. Driver 2 stated that the light had changed and that braking was delayed. Photographs
taken at the scene confirm the general position of both vehicles and the location of the main impact damage. No
independent witnesses were located, and no other vehicles were involved. Several light scratches on the rear bumper
of Driver 1's vehicle appear older than the present damage, and it could not be determined from the scene whether all
of the damage resulted from this impact. The passenger in Driver 1's vehicle was not injured. Driver 1 was identified
as the named driver on the insurance policy for the vehicle. The name of the claimant was not provided at the scene,
and a claim was reported by the same individual several days later.
